t: A condition that reads as very small
a: مَا مِنْ عَبْدٍ قَالَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ. ثُمَّ مَاتَ عَلَى ذَلِكَ، إِلاَّ دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ
m: No servant says there is no god but Allah and then dies upon that, except that he enters Paradise. I said: even if he commits adultery and steals? He said: even if he commits adultery and steals. Three times.
